decisions.share violation: Paired heap capture and consume are needed when guest string construction or callback unwinds. Ordinary free alone leaves a live cleanup key.
decisions.dialog procedures: Original procedures remain implementation bodies behind native callback entry and teardown admission. FindReplace WM_DESTROY owns modeless template and host resource release.
decisions.synchronous initialization: Set fFree in the designated initializer. It remains TRUE for every selected converter; all other members start at zero. In the early no-converter path unwind32 sees zero message, conversion and owned-key fields, and never reads fFree. Original WM32DDEAck uses fFree to release an EXECUTE pair. The flag requirement is source-contract evidence.
decisions.stack cleanup: Preserve completion after original callback and output conversion. stack_leave already checks !scope->completed; pass only the abnormal flag. Nested finally still releases the stack if unwinding the message raises.
